name: REEM-C
summary: A full-size biped research humanoid from PAL Robotics, sold as an off-the-shelf, ROS-native platform with two force-torque-sensing legs, underactuated hands and a stereo head. REEM-C followed PAL's wheeled REEM service robots and is used for locomotion, manipulation and human-robot interaction research.
notable: Early commercially available ROS-based biped research platform
